means: True if the entry for the index in conf_table is present and at its maximum value, AND the entry for the same index in rdp_table is present and has a value greater than the threshold. False otherwise.
name: confident_rdp_greater_than

means: True if the entry for the index in conf_table is present and at its maximum value, AND the value from rdp_table[index]/div (integer division) is greater than the absolute value of the victim key of the way the victim search chose. An absent entry in rdp_table is treated as a value of 0. False otherwise.
name: confident_table_exceeds_victim

means: True when the entry in rdp_table at the given index is present and its value is greater than rdp_thresh, AND the entry in conf_table at the given index has a value greater than or equal to conf_thresh. False if the rdp_table entry is absent. An entry in conf_table always exists and is initialized to zero.
name: confident_bypass_rdp

means: Reads the victim key of the chosen victim way. Reads the rdp_table entry at the given index; if absent, the value is 0. True if this rdp value, divided by div (integer division), is greater than the absolute value of the victim key, AND the entry in conf_table at the given index has a value greater than or equal to conf_thresh. This word can only be used in bypass_when.
name: confident_bypass_victim

means: True when the rdp_table entry at the index is present and its value is greater than rdp_thresh, AND the conf_table entry at the same index is present and its value is its maximum value (2^width - 1). False otherwise.
name: my_confident_rdp_gt_threshold

means: True when the rdp_table entry at the index is present, its value divided by div (integer division) is greater than the absolute value of the chosen victim's key, AND the conf_table entry at the index is present and its value is its maximum value (2^width - 1). False otherwise. Only for use in bypass_when.
name: my_confident_rdp_exceeds_victim

means: Trains the rdp_table toward the value 'age', scaled by scale, with a minimum difference of min_diff. Simultaneously, decrements the conf_table entry at the same index. The rdp_table training is identical to the 'toward' TrainOp. The conf_table training is identical to the 'decrement' TrainOp.
name: train_rdp_toward_conf_dec

means: Increments the rdp_table entry at the given index. Simultaneously, increments the conf_table entry at the same index. The training for each table is identical to the 'increment' TrainOp.
name: train_rdp_inc_conf_inc

means: Reads the entry from the table at the index, an unsigned value. Divides it by div (integer division). Returns the negation of the result, as a two's complement number with the same width as the target field. An absent entry is treated as 0, so the result is 0.
name: negate_table_value

means: Reads the rdp_table entry at the given index; if absent, the value is 0. This is the incoming line's predicted RDP value. Reads the victim key of the chosen victim way. This is the victim_etr. Calculates a threshold as the absolute value of victim_etr multiplied by the multiplier, to approximate the victim's original RDP value. True if the incoming line's predicted RDP value is greater than this calculated threshold. False otherwise. This word can only be used in a 'bypass_when' clause.
name: incoming_rdp_worse_than_victim

means: True if the entry in rdp_table at the given index is present and its value is greater than rdp_thresh, AND the entry in conf_table at the given index has a value of at least conf_thresh. False if the rdp_table entry is absent.
name: my_confident_bypass_rdp

means: Reads the victim key of the chosen victim way. Reads the rdp_table entry at the given index; if absent, the value is 0. True if this rdp value, divided by div (integer division), is greater than the absolute value of the victim key, AND the entry in conf_table at the given index has a value of at least conf_thresh. This word can only be used in bypass_when.
name: my_confident_bypass_victim
